title: Membrane Stack — layers from crust to heliosphere
description: Crust (seismic) → magnetosphere (Kp) → ionosphere (X-ray) → heliosphere (solar wind). The stack is coupled. Space weather modulates every layer. See space-weather-forecast.json.
